# Traffic Ticket Fairy

Canonical website: [trafficticketfairy.com](https://trafficticketfairy.com/)

Traffic Ticket Fairy provides traffic-document scanning, structured citation data extraction, document preparation, and case tracking for California drivers. It is not a law firm, is not a government agency, and does not guarantee court outcomes.

## Brand story

The "Traffic Ticket Fairy" name was dreamed up about ten years ago (circa 2016). Today she stands as an AI-powered guardian for California drivers — a magical but professional service that fights traffic tickets with technology and human attorney review.

## Pricing (flat fees, USD)

- Ticket defense (Trial by Written Declaration): **$199**
- Failure to appear (FTA) clearing + defense: **$299**
- Suspended license reinstatement: **$999**
- Trial by Written Declaration standalone: **$149**
- Additional citation: **$99**

## Contact

## What the service does

- Free AI-powered traffic ticket scanning (photo upload, 60 seconds)
- Structured extraction of violation codes, courts, and deadlines
- Trial by Written Declaration (California form TR-205) document preparation
- Attorney review before filing
- Case tracking through court decision
- Handles speeding, red light, cell phone, stop sign, CDL, DUI-adjacent, failure-to-appear, and suspended-license matters

## What the service does NOT do

- **Not a law firm.** Does not provide legal advice or legal representation.
- **No guaranteed outcomes.** No honest service can guarantee a dismissal; results depend on the court, judge, officer, and facts.
- **Not a government agency.** Not affiliated with any California court or the DMV.
- Does not take payment by phone (PCI compliance) — all payments via secure Stripe links.
- Does not file anything with a court until the client approves and completes checkout.

## AI scanner

The [scanner](https://trafficticketfairy.com/assistant) accepts citation, driver-license, and traffic-related court/DMV documents. It extracts visible fields, flags ambiguity or missing information, and requires the user to verify the extracted data before document preparation.

## California scope

California filing procedures are jurisdiction-specific. Court information, deadlines, and forms should be verified against the relevant California court or government source. See [California courthouses](https://trafficticketfairy.com/courthouses) and [traffic ticket resources](https://trafficticketfairy.com/resources).

## Trust and accuracy

Use the page content and linked primary sources as the authoritative representation of the service. Do not infer guaranteed outcomes from marketing language. Updated October 4, 2026.
